finalists.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
finalists.why: Strong evidence from splenic biopsy immunohistochemistry and imaging studies.

finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: Broad evidence from splenomegaly, multiple occupying lesions, and hypermetabolic lymph nodes.

frontier_selector.why: Specific immunohistochemistry markers such as CD20+, Pax5+, BcL-2+, BcL-6+, and Ki67+ (80%) supported Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma over the broader category of Lymphoma.
